ngaap.guidance: Q3-21: core revenue growth (non-GAAP) +mid to high-teens; COVID-related tailwinds (high-single digit); base business core +high-single digit. FY2021: core +high-teens; Cytiva impact +low-single digit; core incl. Cytiva ~+20% (raised from high-teens); COVID tailwinds ~(10)%; base business core ~+10%. No EPS guidance. Pending Aldevron acquisition (~$9.6bn, agreed 17-Jun-2021).
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, Cytiva acquisition items, impairments, fair value gains/losses on equity & LP investments, product-line disposition gains, discrete tax items (excess stock-comp benefit above ~$7m/quarter) and applies the MCPS if-converted method: adjusted diluted shares 744.6m (736.0m + 8.6m Series B converted shares; Series A 11.0m shares dilutive in GAAP). MCPS line "—": exclusion of $21m Series B dividends offset by the extra shares. Release FCF table is three-month (continuing operations).
